description.en: The ID of the call center.

description.zh: 批次名称；按照名称删除，会删除最近添加的批次
description.en: The name of the batch. If you specify a batch by name, the most recently added batch with that name is deleted.

description.zh: 号码状态；0:未呼叫 1:已呼叫
description.en: The number status. Valid values: `0` (Not called) and `1` (Called).

description.zh: 电话号码；支持多个，多个号码用英文逗号","分隔；任务在运行中，号码也会被删除，最多支持10W个号码；支持加密号码删除，加密号码传参时需URL Encode
description.en: The phone numbers to delete. Separate multiple numbers with commas (,). You can delete up to 100,000 numbers per request, even while the task is running. To delete encrypted numbers, ensure they are URL-encoded.
